hook: The last Muslim king of Spain handed his palace to his enemies, then turned back and wept.
kicker: THE LAST MUSLIM KING OF SPAIN
title: Spain's Last Muslim King Cried Leaving This Palace
desc:
On 2 January 1492 Boabdil handed the keys of the Alhambra to Ferdinand and Isabella. Legend says he turned for one last look at Granada and wept, and his mother had harsh words for him.
Watch the full story on our YouTube channel.

hook: Muslim Spain had street lamps and public baths when most of Europe had none.
title: How Muslims Ruled Spain for 781 Years
desc:
A small army crossed from Africa in 711 and stayed for 781 years. Its cities had street lamps, baths and libraries. So how did it begin, and why did it fall?
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

hook: Gibraltar is named after one Muslim general who landed there in 711.
title: Gibraltar Is Named After a Muslim General
desc:
In 711 Tariq ibn Ziyad crossed from Africa with about 7,000 men and landed below a huge rock. Jabal Tariq, the mountain of Tariq. Today we say Gibraltar.
Full story on our YouTube channel.

#Shorts #History #AlAndalus #Spain #MuslimSpain

hook: He burned his own boats so his army could never turn back.
title: He Burned His Own Boats So His Army Couldn't Run
desc:
"The sea is behind you, the enemy is in front of you." Tariq's 7,000 men faced a far bigger Visigoth army, and within seven years almost all of Spain had fallen.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

hook: One cold mountain valley never surrendered, and it grew into Spain.
title: The Tiny Valley That Created Spain
desc:
After 711 almost the whole peninsula fell, except the rocky far north. At Covadonga Pelayo beat a Muslim force and founded a tiny kingdom that would one day become Spain.
Full story on our YouTube channel.

hook: A twenty-year-old prince escaped a massacre by swimming across a river.
title: He Swam Across a River to Escape a Massacre
desc:
In 750 the Abbasids hunted down almost every Umayyad. One prince, Abd al-Rahman, jumped into the Euphrates with soldiers behind him. His brother turned back. He kept swimming.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

#Shorts #History #AlAndalus #Spain #MuslimSpain

hook: A prince on the run built one of the most beautiful buildings on Earth.
title: From Runaway Prince to Ruler of Spain
desc:
Five years on the run, then in 755 Abd al-Rahman landed in Al-Andalus, took Cordoba and started the Great Mosque with its red and white arches, still standing today.
Full story on our YouTube channel.

#Shorts #History #AlAndalus #Spain #MuslimSpain

hook: This city had lit streets when London was still small.
title: This City Had Street Lights When London Had Mud
desc:
Cordoba may have had a few hundred thousand people when Paris and London were small towns: paved streets, hundreds of baths, running water and a library said to hold 400,000 books.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

#Shorts #History #AlAndalus #Spain #MuslimSpain

hook: A man in Spain tried to fly six hundred years before Leonardo da Vinci.
title: This Man Flew 600 Years Before Leonardo da Vinci
desc:
Abbas ibn Firnas is said to have strapped on wings and glided in 9th-century Cordoba. Around him: new crops, paper mills and scholars whose books changed Europe.
Full story on our YouTube channel.

#Shorts #History #AlAndalus #Spain #MuslimSpain

hook: Muslims, Christians and Jews lived side by side, but it was not equality.
title: Muslims, Christians and Jews Lived Together, But Not as Equals
desc:
A Jewish doctor could be a top minister to the caliph, yet Christians and Jews paid extra taxes and could not rule over Muslims. Tolerance, with rules.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

#Shorts #History #AlAndalus #Spain #MuslimSpain

hook: He made prisoners carry church bells all the way across Spain.
title: He Stole a Cathedral's Bells and Made Prisoners Carry Them
desc:
Al-Mansur raided the Christian north more than fifty times. In 997 he sacked Santiago de Compostela and made prisoners carry its bells to Cordoba. Then it all fell apart.
Full story on our YouTube channel.

#Shorts #History #AlAndalus #Spain #MuslimSpain

hook: Muslim kings paid Christian kings to protect them from each other.
title: The Mistake That Destroyed Muslim Spain
desc:
Al-Andalus split into twenty-plus small kingdoms. Some paid Christian kings for protection. When Toledo fell they called in the Almoravids, who took over.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

#Shorts #History #AlAndalus #Spain #MuslimSpain

hook: Two teenagers married in secret, and it ended a 781-year story.
title: The Secret Wedding That Ended Muslim Spain
desc:
In 1469 Isabella of Castile and Ferdinand of Aragon married in secret. Together they went to war with a Granada already split by a prince fighting his own father.
Full story on our YouTube channel.

hook: They built a whole city just to show they were never leaving.
title: They Built a Whole City Just to Win One Siege
desc:
In 1491 the Christian army built Santa Fe, a town of stone outside Granada. Starving, Boabdil surrendered, and on 2 January 1492 the cross rose over the Alhambra.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.

hook: You speak Arabic every time you say ojala.
title: You Speak Arabic Every Time You Speak Spanish
desc:
Aceite, azucar, alcalde, even ojala, from 'if God wills'. Al-Andalus never really left Spain, and in 1492 a new story began.
